caption: The drawing consists of a symmetrical arrangement of objects on a textured, light brown background with a darker border. At the top, there is a stylized cross in shades of ochre yellow, outlined in reddish-brown with blue details and yellow radiating lines. Below the cross, there is a circular element with a blue border and an inner circle made of intricate, repeating, petal-like shapes in blue, ochre yellow, and reddish-brown, suggesting a mandala or sun design. Attached to the base of the cross and overlapping the upper part of the circle is a central, blue-bordered bow shape with four elongated loops, each colored ochre yellow and outlined in reddish-brown with red inner dots. On either side of the bow, there are symmetrical wing-like shapes in ochre yellow with reddish-brown tips. The whole composition is vertically aligned and uses a color palette of ochre yellow, reddish-brown, light blue, and some small accents of light green.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
